sections.text_helper: Section 35.4.4 "ADC slave interface (ADCITF)" in chapter 35 (Multi-function digital filter (MDF)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1635.
sections.section_content:
The ADCs are not always connected to the MDF. Refer to Section35.3 to check the
situation for this product.
The MDF allows the connection of up to two ADCs to the filter path. For each filter, the
DATSRC[1:0] bitfield in the MDF digital filter configuration register x (MDF_DFLTxCICR)
allows the application to select either data from the ADCs.
Warning: The MDF does not support receiving interleaved data from
one of the ADCITF input.
